digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-1 finder and gate model selection
propositions: Pass-1 finder model was silently downgraded from opus to sonnet on 2026-06-27 by _verifier_cfg landing, then further to haiku by b690 honouring req.config with plan-review.yaml declaring trivial rung
b690 enables ladder rungs to influence Pass-1 by honouring req.config where PydanticAIRunner.run previously discarded it, exposing the incorrect trivial declaration
Pass-1 generates blocking findings that gate claims, so downgrading finder capability without alarm creates a silently more permissive gate that offline test suite cannot detect
Sidecar records show 115 plan-review findings generated on opus through 2026-06-27, then zero ever since—a total changeover proving the regression
Prerequisite finder bin packing targets cfg.model for window sizing, causing incorrect haiku (200k) packing instead of opus/sonnet (1M) on context escalation
Restoring Pass-1 rung to frontier (opus) and asserting effective model at the runner seam prevents future silent finder downgrades
